\begin{example} \end{example}[The Rotation Field]

1. ch8:8.17For $F\colon \mathbb {R}\to \mathbb {R}^2$ given by $F(t)=(\cos t,\sin t)$, the field $d/dt$ is $F$-related to \[ Y=x\frac{\partial }{\partial y}-y\frac{\partial }{\partial x}. \] \end{example}
